focus.name: player-collision-current-actor-type-static
focus.purpose: Name the transient actor-type byte published by the player-collision pass without claiming an unresolved downstream reader.

contracts: After an overlap, Actor_PlayerCollisionPass copies the candidate actor type to 0x00FFF0F6 at 0x001ABC90 before indirect dispatch through PLAYER_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE.
No current whole-ROM reader or higher-level consumer is claimed.
conclusion: 0x00FFF0F6 has a stable transient player-collision actor-type identity while any downstream handler-visible role remains explicitly open.
